newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 26.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The 12 projects of the African Elephant: A preview of major construction works, including Abidjan airport, motorways and bridges that paper says will change the face of Ivory Coast.

- Commodity exporters group GEPEX invites cocoa and coffee buyers who applied for 1996/97 purchase licences to collect their certificates by January 15 deadline. Only those with certificates will be considered licensed buyers, notice says.
- Four university student leaders arrested on charges of belonging to illegal organisation held in Abidjan prison.
- Sixteen African countries deprived of flights because of strike by air traffic controllers; flights could resume today.
